title: Consumer Credit Default Risk & Portfolio Monitoring

source.dataBoundary: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients, CC BY 4.0. The full licensed source rows are owner-approved for the public read-only analyst workspace; demographics remain excluded from model inputs and recommendations.

evidence.claim: The existing deployed dashboard serves aggregate retrospective evidence only; the verified full-record replacement is not yet deployed.
The calibrated challenger achieved AUROC 0.7915, PR-AUC 0.5737, Brier score 0.1315, and 10-bin calibration error 0.0120 on the fixed stratified UCI benchmark split.
